testcase.name: Scenario: Keep two selected staged commands in order when moving down: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/ribbon-customization-identity-support/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:920:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep two selected staged commands in order when moving down ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And the user has staged these commands in order: | 2-D Drawing | | 2D Sketches | | 3D Annotations | ✔ When the user selects "2-D Drawing" and extends the selection down to "2D Sketches" ✔ And the user clicks the down ordering button ✔ Then the custom panel list remains in this order: | 2-D Drawing | | 2D Sketches | | 3D Annotations | ✔ And the first two rows remain selected ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
